Hi! I'm a research leader with 7+ years of experience in AI governance and human oversight of safety-critical automation. I build 0-to-1 research programs, controlled experiments, and risk assessments. My work has informed national nuclear safety regulation, enterprise AI deployment strategy, and ML product design for global teams.

If you'd like to learn more about what I do, take a look at some recent work:

-   [Trust in human-AI interactions](https://srinstitute.utoronto.ca/s/SRI_Trust_in_human_AI_interactions_2026-06-09.pdf) (2026) is an investigation on how trust is conceptualized across different disciplines.

-   [A human-subjects experiment](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0004370223000917) (2023) testing the influence of different types of explanations of ML advice on user decisions, published in *Artificial Intelligence*.

-   [A follow-up experiment](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1071581924002179) (2025) integrating counterfactual explanations, published in *International Journal of Human-Computer Studies*.

Full list of publications on [Google Scholar →](https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=list_works&hl=en&hl=en&user=hpdB69EAAAAJ)
